purpose: Keep the existing OnboardAI 40-feature teacher geometrically consistent before real Gazebo RGB/Depth fine-tuning.

items: neutral target distance, bearing and N/E regression share one metric scale
INSPECT/FOLLOW and MATCH/FOLLOW phase labels derive N/E from observed bearing and range
bearing anchors cover symmetric angles with independent source groups
bearing comes from CameraInfo-bound calibration when available
NED labels reuse the runtime target-ray and camera-lever-arm transform
missing calibration never receives a fabricated direction label

next_required_input: Three approved entity-based Gazebo scenes with sealed RGB, metric FLOAT32 depth, CameraInfo, synchronized PX4 telemetry, detector/tracker outputs, and independently reviewed train/evaluation episodes.
